summary:
w115 is planned; the plan is plan.md in the run directory.
All 8 accepted scenarios (r47, r58, r59, r57) pass at HEAD already, and the retired @r47 deprecated scenario is no longer in the feature.
The work left is the w110 finding: an empty session.json names every run of its stage (probe A).
Decision: within each work-item and stage, run directories <k>-<stage> in ascending k are paired with that stage's ended start rows in log order, so only the empty run is named (r57 and the work-item's ruling). supervise_worker.py is not changed.
The red test is a new script test, tests/scripts/test_measure_runs.py, not a new scenario.
The totals' sessions counts only sessions with figures (ruling B).
No existing test breaks.
Left out of scope for the coordinator: lowercase z, a whitespace-only session.json, measure show not printing the empty naming, and a U+2028 commit subject crashing merged_commits (D2).
